newsitem.title: USA: Children's Comprehensive to buy Vendell.
newsitem.headline: Children's Comprehensive to buy Vendell.

text.p: Children's Comprehensive Services Inc said Wednesday that a bankruptcy court has approved the sale to it of the assets of Vendell Healthcare Inc and two of Vendell's subsidiaries.

Vendell and the subsidiaries previously filed for Chapter 11 proceedings as part of the negotiated sale to Children's Comprehensive, and the Tennessee court's approval was a condition to closing the sale.

Other significant conditions remain, but the court's approval is a major step towards the closing of the deal, which the parties expect to take place within the next 30 to 45 days, Children's Comprehensive said.

In February, Children's Comprehensive agreed to buy the Vendell companies' assets for about $24 million to be paid with $16 million in cash and $8 million in shares of Children's Comprehensive common shares.
Based in Nashville, Vendell currently operates eight residential facilities and 17 day-treatment facilities.

In the proposed deal, Children's Comprehensive will buy seven of the residential facilities and 13 of the day-treatment units located in Arkansas, Florida, Kentucky, Michigan, Montana, Texas and Utah.
